params.body:
On the photos tab every tile in the top gallery carried a pair: the dealer's own photo on the left, the processed platform copy (background removed, plate blurred) on the right. The platform gallery below shows exactly those copies again, so each platform photo stood on the page twice, and neither half got the width the grid was built for.

One photo per tile now. The top gallery is the dealer's own photos (the edited version when there is one, otherwise the original); the platform copies live only in the gallery below, with their own actions.

## The labels

They are gone. With one photo per tile, "EIGEN AANBOD" on every tile in a section headed "Eigen aanbod (niet geblurd)" says the same thing twice, and the same for the platform half. The two section headings already carry the distinction, and they carry it once. The five-language label map in `image.blade.php` (`$lbl`) and the `voor`/`na` entries in `photos.blade.php` had no reader left and are removed; the lightbox caption went with them, for the same reason (every image in a group would have got the name of the group).

## What else came loose

- `$slVersion` is still handed to the tile, but only to know whether a platform copy exists: that is what `has_transparant` / `doesnt_have_transparant` mean, and `vehicle.js` (`removeBgSelected`) aims at the second one. `$slByOrigin` keeps its other job as well, the `heeft-achtergrond` class the "only with background" filter reads.
- `$heeftNaVersies` in `photos.blade.php` had no reader at all and is gone.
- The `fotoview` state in the toolbar's Alpine scope always held `'voor'` since the own/platform switch was removed; the grid class is now just the filter.
- refresh.css: `.ba-pair`, `.ba-voor`, `.ba-na`, `.ba-label` and the `.ui-fotoview-before` / `.ui-fotoview-after` / `.ui-fotoview-choice` rules that hung on them are removed (about 60 lines). `.ba-cel` takes over the rounded corner and the grey ground the pair carried; the two `:has(.ba-pair)` selectors that make the tile a card became `:has(.ba-cel)`. `.ui-fotoview-wrap` stays: `vehicle.js` selects it to recount after a delete.
- `closeIframe` in `vehicle_form_preview.blade.php` sets the src of `.ba-img` inside the tile; it used to hit both halves, now it hits the one photo that was actually edited.
- The per-tile "duplicate", the bulk duplicate and the background choice all still make sense: they are about what the platform copy becomes, and the result now appears in one place instead of two.

Nothing changed about what the buttons do. The seal, the upload flow, the processing and the webhooks are untouched.

## The grid

One image per tile means each image is twice as wide as before at the same column count, so on a wide screen a thumbnail became 350 px. A fifth column from 1400 px keeps them at the size a gallery of thirty photos wants; below that the steps (2 / 3 / 4) are unchanged.

## Tests

`PhotoGalleriesSeparateTest` renders the tab for a vehicle with three own photos, two of which have a platform copy: every tile in the top gallery carries exactly one image, each platform photo is in the platform grid, and nowhere else on the page. Tagged `@rule S1-6.24`, the screen rule added to `docs/bedrijfsregels/11-s1-wagen-invoeren-en-beheren.md`; `92-testdekking.md` and `docs/bedrijfsregels.html` regenerated.

`php artisan test --filter='Photo|Image|OwnStock|VehicleForm|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage'`: 70 tests, 904 assertions, green. Rendered through the running application at 1600 px and on a phone.
params.title: One photo per tile: the two galleries stop overlapping
